quality_assessment: Page documents Files Mode, Type List Mode, and Generation Mode well, but is missing documentation for several utility features from the feature inventory: counting, statistics, passthru mode, and hyperlinks. Also contains broken cross-reference links.

issues.fix_suggestion: Add section documenting counting modes: -c/--count for match counts per file, --count-matches for total match count across files, and --include-zero for including zero-count files. This is distinct from statistics mode.

Add section documenting statistics mode with --stats flag that shows detailed statistics including files searched count, matches found count, bytes searched, time elapsed, and JSON format availability. Note: This feature is documented in a separate statistics.md file, so consider cross-referencing instead of duplicating.
Add section documenting passthru mode: --passthru flag that prints all lines with matches highlighted, useful for log analysis, and can combine with context flags.

Add section documenting hyperlinks feature: --hyperlink-format for custom hyperlink format supporting VSCode, file://, and custom formats for click-to-open in editor functionality (requires terminal support). Note: This feature is documented in a separate hyperlinks.md file, so consider cross-referencing instead of duplicating.
